limitations: Single trial per mode on shared host; observations are not universal bounds or a comprehensive ranking.
Burst offered load follows API throughput, not a fixed offered rate.
Native benchmark retains idle lifecycle preflight Gateway/backend; Agentgateway uses its benchmark installation.
Gateway-only reboot proof uses external backend/no Pod reservations; full Pod restart remains blocked by podster-z3h.
Historical pre-integration full suite had29 package-export failures; incoming main fixed those expectations. See integrationForMain for the passing final gate.
Old control is partial; only a matched2463-route prefix comparison is reported, not a full3000 old mean.

GC and periodic full work both contribute to growing stalls; heap tuning reduces GC time but is not a complete latency fix. Allocation attribution is process-wide or inclusive; neither gives exclusive function allocations.

volatileViewRecovery.native: See nativeGatewayRecovery exact healthy external-backend scope and separate integratedPodRestart failure.

gcDiagnostic.scope: Instrumented diagnostic 3000-route burst; separate from uninstrumented comparison.
gcDiagnostic.gc_counter_scope: Runtime-reported GC wall time alone does not exclude GC coordination overhead. Lisp sampler gap is an independent liveness observation; long gaps can also reflect scheduling. Source reviewed: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sbcl/sbcl/master/src/code/gc.lisp
gcDiagnostic.gc_upper_bound_method: GC counter difference between last event/sample before inferred post-apply start and first event/sample after completion. Bracketing overestimates the runtime-reported collector time within each request interval; post-start inferred from monotonic probe duration and completion UTC log.
gcDiagnostic.allocation_counter_scope: Process-wide allocation increments during intervals, not exclusive function allocations; concurrent/nested operation intervals overlap.

heapComparison.scope: Same pre-copy-reduction binary and instrumentation, one 3000-route burst per heap size; separate from uninstrumented comparisons. Heap sizing also changes default nursery size. No default heap change made.
